reason: The README clearly describes an agent workflow that classifies creative requests, gathers missing requirements, saves structured briefs, and renders them into actionable generation prompts for short video, brand visual, ecommerce, and game concept work.

summaries.zh: 一个通过领域判定和自适应追问生成结构化创意 brief，并将其渲染为图像、视频和文案生成提示词的创意指导插件。
summaries.en: A creative-director plugin that classifies requests, asks domain-specific follow-up questions, produces structured briefs, and renders them into image, video, and caption prompts.

capabilities: Classifies creative requests into supported domains
Asks adaptive follow-up questions based on domain-specific fields
Validates and locally saves structured creative briefs
Renders briefs into image, video, and caption prompts
